bullets.text: Slower Features for UK Users - **Apple** warns that tighter regulations may delay feature rollouts for UK customers.
Honor Magic V5 Impresses - The **Honor** Magic V5 is just 8.8mm thick, making it one of the slimmest foldables.
Apple TV+ Comedy on BBC - **Apple's** series 'Trying' will be available on **BBC iPlayer**, expanding its audience in the UK.
iPhone Crash Detection Saves Life - A teen's **iPhone** automatically called 911 after a serious crash, showcasing its safety features.
Apple's Legal Battles - **Apple** faces legal challenges over 4G patents, risking a significant financial precedent.
Waymo Loitering Concerns - Residents report **Waymo** robotaxis frequently parking in front of homes, raising privacy issues.
Apple Invites Widget Update - The latest **Apple Invites** update introduces a countdown widget for upcoming events.
Verizon Network Issues - Many **Verizon** customers experienced service outages due to a software issue.
